home.sourcePending: Sources are added as each jurisdiction page is verified.
home.pendingNote: Every figure is verified against a primary source before it appears here. The table goes live one jurisdiction at a time, as each is confirmed.
home.mapIntro: The same four questions answered for each. Which one fits depends less on the threshold than on what you are actually buying: time, a passport, or a tax position.
home.mapNote: Boundaries are simplified for legibility and are not a statement about any border. On narrow screens the annotations become the list above.
home.costHeading: The threshold is not the price
home.costIntro: Every comparison in this category publishes the entry threshold. Almost none publish what it costs to clear it — the transfer taxes, filing fees, government charges and first renewals that are not optional.
home.costNote: All figures in euro, converted where a jurisdiction sets its threshold in another currency, and checked against primary sources. A jurisdiction appears here only once both of its figures have been verified.
home.routeHeading: Three questions instead of an hour-long consultation
home.routeIntro: Nothing is sent until you press the button. The summary rebuilds on every answer.

home.enquiryHeading: Do you know the country — or not yet?
home.enquiryForkChosenBody: The enquiry goes to the lawyer who handles that jurisdiction.
home.enquiryForkOpenBody: Then we work out the case first and show you what there is to choose between.
home.enquiryGoalsHint: Pick as many as apply — the combination is what makes a case specific.
home.enquirySituationHint: Citizenship, family, where the income comes from, what you have already tried — everything that did not fit above.
home.enquiryConsent: I agree that my enquiry may be passed to a specialist partner
home.enquiryFine: We reply within two working days. Enquiries are passed only to partners working in the jurisdiction you selected, and only if you tick the box above. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.
home.enquirySentBody: We reply within two working days, from a person, not a template. If you do not hear back, check the spam folder before assuming we lost it.
home.enquiryFailedBody: An email address and the consent box are the two things we cannot proceed without. Fill both and try again — nothing else you typed was lost.
home.faqCount: Showing {n} of {total} — questions tagged to this jurisdiction only. Select “All” for the general ones.
home.faqNote: Answers are checked against primary sources and dated. None of them is legal advice — rules change, and your case may not reduce to them.
